  context={"endpoint"}

Sends three ICMP echo requests from the host and reports how many came back, and their round-trip times. A host that does not answer is 100% loss, not an error. It changes nothing, so it reports changed: false. On Linux the agent pings without root when net.ipv4.ping_group_range admits its group.
